name: Variances
rows: Variances Over the Threshold and the Commentary (BVA-3, BVA-5)
Every variance more than 5% of budget and more than $10,000. Each explanation was tested against the ledger lines on GL Drill-Down.
Variance
Amount
Percent of Budget
Explanation
Commentary for the CFO
OPS · Contract revenue (4100, 4150) · October
Supported by the ledger

Contract revenue was $253,592.00 against a budget of $439,000.00, $185,408.00 (42.2%) under. Larch Hollow Building 3 (S-2610) earned $22,915.13 against $118,000.00: its estimate rose for rock excavation and a retaining wall that were not in the bid, which lowered its percent complete, and the whole estimated loss is booked (permanent); the $40,000.00 of new work budgeted to start in October has not been awarded (permanent for the month); Ridgecrest (S-2607) earned nothing against $38,000.00 because its estimate was not revised and revenue is held at September's level (timing, an open item). The other jobs together were $12,323.13 under.
OPS · Contract costs (5100, 5150) · October
Supported by the ledger

Contract costs were $335,981.42 against $390,135.00, $54,153.58 under budget, but only because volume was down. At October's actual revenue the flex budget allows $225,239.41; actual costs are $110,742.01 over it. That margin variance is S-2610 ($96,432.38, including the $5,791.42 loss provision) and S-2607 ($21,350.00), partly offset by S-2601 (+$8,244.63).
FLD · 6200 Equipment Repairs and Maintenance · October
Not supported; returned to the owner (BVA-5)

Equipment Repairs and Maintenance were $13,660.00 against $1,600.00. One invoice, the $11,850.00 excavator hydraulic pump rebuild (Tamarack Equipment Service 2291), is 98% of the variance; routine repairs were $1,810.00, $210.00 over budget. The department's note cites fuel and a heavier schedule; the ledger does not support it (fuel was $1,984.85 under budget for October; contract volume was 42.2% under budget). The rebuild may be a capital item under BVA-7; if the Controller capitalizes it, October repairs fall to $1,810.00. One-time; no change to the rest of the year.
PRE · 6400 Software and Subscriptions · October
Supported; the posting is corrected by RC-01

Software and Subscriptions was $17,600.00 against $800.00. $16,800.00 of it is the annual estimating software plan for November 2026 to October 2027, paid in October and expensed in full; it belongs in prepaid expenses and is expensed at $1,400.00 a month from November. RC-01 proposes the correction. Corrected, October is $800.00, on budget. From November the plan costs $600.00 a month more than budgeted, $4,800.00 for the rest of the year.
GA · 6450 Professional Fees · October
Supported by the ledger

Professional Fees were $11,340.00 against $600.00: lien rights review and collections letter, Orchard Gate (S-2598), $10,740.00 (Pellam Kirsch LLP). One-time; a smaller follow-up, $5,000.00 over November and December, is in the reforecast.
OPS · Contract revenue (4100, 4150) · Year to date
Supported by the ledger
Year to date, contract revenue is $1,308,734.10 against $1,507,000.00, $198,265.90 (13.2%) under. July to September ran $12,857.90 under, so October explains 93% of the gap.
OPS · Contract costs (5100, 5150) · Year to date
Supported by the ledger

Year to date, contract costs are $1,248,827.75 against $1,340,845.00, $92,017.25 under budget; flexed to actual revenue they should be $1,164,102.99, so the year's margin variance is $84,724.76 unfavorable and the volume variance $21,523.89 unfavorable.
FLD · 6200 Equipment Repairs and Maintenance · Year to date
Not supported; returned to the owner (BVA-5)
Year to date $18,489.65 against $6,400.00, $12,089.65 over: the October item above; July to September were $29.65 over budget.

Supported; the posting is corrected by RC-01
Year to date $20,000.00 against $3,200.00, $16,800.00 over: the October item above; July to September were on budget.
